coreLoop: Heroes or characters fight automatically and continue generating useful idle or offline progression resources between active sessions.

signatureSystems.name: Resource Management
signatureSystems.purpose: To manage and optimize the resources used in the game, ensuring that the players can progress efficiently and effectively without the need for frequent input or decisions.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can choose which resource management system they want to use, such as maximizing the use of idle time or investing in specific skills or gear.

signatureSystems.name: Progression System
signatureSystems.purpose: To provide a clear and understandable progression system that allows players to easily understand how their progress is being tracked and improved.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can choose which progression system they want to use, such as leveling up or upgrading their gear.

signatureSystems.name: Risk Management
signatureSystems.purpose: To manage and mitigate the risks associated with the game, ensuring that players can make informed decisions and avoid potential pitfalls.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can choose which risk management system they want to use, such as avoiding certain stages or bosses or investing in specific skills or gear.
